neighbours.label: 'Price…' as the start of an online brand name (Priceline, PriceRunner, PriceGrabber), not the common noun and not other website names
fire: We found the cheapest room on Priceline after an hour of searching.
Shoppers in Denmark often check PriceRunner before they buy a phone.
The airline also sells its unsold seats through Priceline and Hotwire.
According to PriceGrabber, the camera costs less online than in stores.
Rival sites such as Kayak, Orbitz and Priceline lost visitors last year.
The laptop was listed on Kelkoo, Idealo and PriceRunner at the same time.
My sister booked her rental car with Priceline and saved forty dollars.
Comparison engines like Shopzilla and PriceGrabber take a small commission.
quiet: We found the cheapest room on Expedia after an hour of searching.
Shoppers in Denmark often check the price twice before they buy a phone.
The airline also sells its unsold seats through Travelocity and Hotwire.
According to the retailer, the camera costs less online than in stores.
Rival sites such as Kayak, Orbitz and Trivago lost visitors last year.
The laptop was listed on Kelkoo, Idealo and Amazon at the same time.
My sister booked her rental car at a fair price and saved forty dollars.
Comparison engines like Shopzilla and Bizrate take a small commission.

notes: Card: 'ric' (P-ric-eline) is 19 of the top 32 peaks; the rest start other brand or site names (' We' Heart It, ' The' Walking Company, ' Price'Runner, ' Qu'ora). Probes: PriceRunner 0.90, Priceline 0.65, Quora 0.39, The Walking Company 0.37, 'The price of bread' 0.02, We Heart It 0.07. Near misses test both the common noun and other site names, so a wider 'start of a web brand' reading would show up as near-miss leaks.
